behaviors.reason: Released serialized values are Vertical=0/Horizontal=1; native WinUI uses Horizontal=0/Vertical=1. Existing values are preserved.
Segoe UI Variable/Segoe UI/system-ui is a platform fallback stack. Metric equivalence needs licensed font and Windows reference evidence.
The profile implements Gregorian UTC date arithmetic; other CalendarIdentifier values raise SFUI1686.
Bounded text/RTF bold, italic, underline, size and RGB subset; embedded objects and unsupported control words fault explicitly.
A pinned metadata inventory proves reference signatures only. Windows behavior/oracle qualification must be recorded separately.
Released RoutedEventHandler signatures remain fixed. Runtime emits concrete args, but source handlers need explicit casts for added fields.
Sandboxed iframe navigation is implemented; native CoreWebView2/process APIs are unavailable and ExecuteScriptAsync faults SFUI16B5.
Map, camera and animated visual operations require explicit host adapters/grants. Missing capabilities report SFUI1633; they never simulate success.
Actual HTMLMediaElement transport is implemented. Codec availability, DRM and real device playback need scoped platform evidence.
UTF-16 composition transactions and cancellation are implemented; synthetic events do not qualify Windows CJK/RTL IME behavior.
Browser dragstart cannot await a worker response. In-process cancellation is supported; worker tab-drag cancellation needs a custom drag gesture.
